_comment: Realistic mock of a Polymarket Gamma REST market object, captured live on 2026-07-28. This is the shape _fetch_market_prices() receives. NOTE: outcomes/outcomePrices/clobTokenIds are JSON-ENCODED STRINGS, not arrays - that is the real API shape and the reason the price was never extracted. Companion to polymarket_price_update.json, which mocks the WebSocket path.
